originalTitle: AI cloud provider Nscale files to go public
summary: Nscale is the latest artificial intelligence neocloud to turn to public markets.
content:
Nscale, a cloud provider specializing in infrastructure for artificial intelligence models, has filed to go public on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker symbol "NSCL."

The company had a $1.02 billion net loss on $140.6 million in revenue in the six months ended June 30, 2026, according to its prospectus for an initial public offering. The net loss over the same time period a year earlier was $368.9 million, while revenue was up 1,252% from $10.4 million.

Nscale pointed to $56.4 billion in remaining performance obligations.

Competitors include market-leading cloud providers such as Amazon , as well as younger AI-centric suppliers like CoreWeave and Nebius that are known as neoclouds.

OpenAI, Anthropic and other labs have had seemingly endless thirst for more computing capacity since the release of ChatGPT in 2022, as people tap generative AI products for coding, productivity and general chat. As a result, Anthropic and OpenAI have required impressive amounts of cash to pay its computing bills, and both are planning to go public.

Both of those labs have struck deals with Nscale, which rents out Nvidia graphics processing units (GPUs) for training and running models. Microsoft , itself a cloud provider, has also signed up with Nscale. One unnamed customer accounted for over half of revenue in the first half of 2026.

Nscale has sought to diversify. It now offers to handle inference requests for a slew of models. In July it announced plans to acquire statup Anyscale, whose software helps with the construction of AI models.

Last week Nscale said Fidji Simo, a former OpenAI, Instacart and Meta executive, was joining its board. In July she stepped down from her post as OpenAI's product and business chief after taking medical leave. Other board members include former Meta leaders Nick Clegg and Sheryl Sandberg.

London-based Nscale had over 1,000 full-time employees as of Aug. 31.

As of Aug. 31, Nscale held 25,000 active GPUs and 461,000 that were either active or contracted, with five active and 12 contracted data center sites. It has line of sight to 10 gigawatts' worth of computing power, while sitting on more than $8 billion in debt, excluding a financing arrangement with AI server maker Dell .

The company emerged from stealth mode in 2024, spinning out of cryptocurrency mining firm Arkon Energy. Investors include Blue Owl, Dell, Nvidia, Fidelity and Point72. In March the company said investors had valued it at $14.6 billion in a funding round. Nvidia agreed to guarantee up to $860 million on Nscale's obligations for a data center lease agreement in Texas, according to the filing.

"From inception, we built Nscale with an infrastructure-first thesis, building against contracted customer demand, underwriting projects to attractive long-term returns, maintaining prudent leverage and seeking to match the duration of our capital commitments with the strong revenues supporting them," Josh Payne, Nscale's 32-year-old founder, chair and CEO, wrote in a letter to prospective investors included with the filing. "That discipline remains central to how we scale."

chineseTitle: AI 云提供商Nscale文件拟上市
chineseSummary: Nscale 是最新进入公开市场的人工智能新云。
chineseContent:
Nscale 是一家专注于人工智能模型基础设施的云提供商，已申请在纽约证券交易所上市，股票代码为“NSCL”。

根据其首次公开募股说明书，该公司截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止六个月的净亏损为 10.2 亿美元，收入为 1.406 亿美元。去年同期净亏损为 3.689 亿美元，而收入则较上年同期的 1,040 万美元增长 1,252%。

Nscale 指出剩余履约义务为 564 亿美元。

竞争对手包括亚马逊等市场领先的云提供商，以及 CoreWeave 和 Nebius 等年轻的以人工智能为中心的供应商（被称为 Neoclouds）。

自 2022 年 ChatGPT 发布以来，随着人们利用生成式 AI 产品进行编码、提高生产力和一般聊天，OpenAI、Anthropic 和其他实验室似乎对更多计算能力有着无尽的渴望。因此，Anthropic 和 OpenAI 需要大量现金来支付其计算费用，并且都计划上市。

这两个实验室都与 Nscale 达成了协议，后者出租 Nvidia 图形处理单元 (GPU) 用于训练和运行模型。微软本身也是一家云提供商，也已与 Nscale 签约。一位未透露姓名的客户占 2026 年上半年收入的一半以上。

Nscale 一直在寻求多元化发展。它现在可以处理大量模型的推理请求。 7月份，它宣布计划收购初创公司Anyscale，该公司的软件有助于构建人工智能模型。

上周，Nscale 表示，前 OpenAI、Instacart 和 Meta 高管 Fidji Simo 将加入其董事会。今年 7 月，她在休病假后辞去了 OpenAI 产品和业务负责人的职务。其他董事会成员包括前 Meta 领导人 Nick Clegg 和 Sheryl Sandberg。

截至 8 月 31 日，总部位于伦敦的 Nscale 拥有 1,000 多名全职员工。

截至 8 月 31 日，Nscale 拥有 25,000 个活跃 GPU 和 461,000 个活跃或签约 GPU，其中有 5 个活跃数据中心站点和 12 个签约数据中心站点。它拥有价值 10 吉瓦的计算能力，但负债超过 80 亿美元（不包括与人工智能服务器制造商戴尔的融资安排）。

该公司于 2024 年摆脱隐秘模式，从加密货币挖矿公司 Arkon Energy 中分拆出来。投资者包括 Blue Owl、戴尔、Nvidia、Fidelity 和 Point72。 3 月份，该公司表示投资者在一轮融资中对其估值为 146 亿美元。文件显示，Nvidia 同意为 Nscale 德克萨斯州数据中心租赁协议的义务提供高达 8.6 亿美元的担保。

Nscale 32 岁的创始人、董事长兼首席执行官乔什·佩恩 (Josh Payne) 在提交给潜在投资者的一封信中写道：“从一开始，我们就以基础设施为先的理念创建了 Nscale，根据合同客户需求，承保具有吸引力的长期回报的项目，保持审慎的杠杆率，并寻求将我们的资本承诺的期限与支持它们的强劲收入相匹配。” “这种纪律仍然是我们扩展规模的核心。”
